procedure: Compared ADR resources with current Dataset, Release, Grant and AccessContext definitions.
Walked two labs, a shared project, a restricted dataset and a fixed historical share through creation, archival and reassignment.
Checked that each mutable transition has authority, concurrency and audit preconditions; traced implementation ownership to F02/F03.

acceptance.criterion: Define stable lab/project identifiers, display metadata, one primary project per dataset, optional links without authority, and independent custody.
acceptance.evidence: ADR Decision and Resources and state

acceptance.criterion: Show examples with two labs, one shared project, one restricted dataset and historical releases; no change to release/content identity or cross-study participant merging.
Specify creation, archival and reassignment semantics and concurrency preconditions; document required API resources and exclusions.
acceptance.evidence: ADR Creation, archival and reassignment; Public API contract to implement

negativeCases: An optional project link cannot grant access.
A project reader cannot discover an ExplicitOnly dataset without a separate grant.
A stale move preview cannot commit after project membership changes.
Matching sub-01 labels do not merge people.
limitations: Design baseline only; organizational runtime behavior remains F02-F06.
No named institution or human acceptance is claimed.
F01.2 and F01.3 supply the linked authority and lifecycle contracts before F01 gate review.
